## The W rule on the committed corpus

50 measured trials (peaks min 930 / median 8,647 / max 116,977): F(32768)=0.22, F(49152)=0.12, F(65536)=0.06, F(98304)=0.04, F(131072)=0.00. F(32768) < 0.25 → **V8/V9 `withheld{inert_at_admissible_window}`** — declared with `declaration`/`forecast`/`override_spellings`, never sealed, never a fabricated W. The composite machinery is still proven at a fixture W (r7_1 AC-3: `cmp_strategy=clear_tool_results` + `window_cap=32768` seals; task-varying W and padding refuse).
